text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, such as data entry and scheduling, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees organise their work, write emails faster, and analyse information. In many companies, human-AI collaboration is becoming normal. People focus on creative and social tasks, while AI supports them with speed and accuracy. However, this shift also brings job changes. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, requiring different skills. For workers, the key to success is learning how to use AI tools effectively and adapting to a rapidly changing workplace.
